elements_selected.content: Implement tests for session tracking functions covering REQ-006. Test 6 scenarios: get_surfaced_penalty returns 1.0 for unseen files, returns penalty^count for seen files, floors at 0.05, detect_circling_topics returns files from similar queries, returns empty set with no prior queries, record_surfaced caps at surfaced_cap. Tests must reset _session_surfaced and _session_queries globals between test methods — use the conftest session reset fixture.
Modified 9 files (+294, -1): pyproject.toml, tests/__init__.py, tests/conftest.py, tests/fixtures/corpus/CLAUDE.md, tests/fixtures/corpus/README.md and 4 more
